body:
Whole Nutmeg
I thought I'd get around the whole 'nasty-taste-nutmeg-problem' by swallowing whole nutmegs. I just took 5 or 6 whole nutmegs with a sports drink.  I take a lot of pills so it was no problem to swallow them.
What I took amounted to approximately 15 grams of nutmeg.
AND: Nothing happened.  Seriously.  No changes of consciousness of any sort.
Since I weigh 150 pounds and took 15 grams of nutmeg, something should have happened.
The point is obvious.  Nutmeg must be ground to have any effect.
